subject.summary: Photo-inferred reconstruction of the orange-ochre Seyfridtzska huset at Stortorget 18, Stockholm: one rounded central gable, curved shoulders, oculus, two window axes and black medieval-type anchor irons. Unseen rear and ground shopfront simplified.

sources.title: Ximonic (Simo Räsänen), Stortorget Christmas Market December 2022
sources.ref: User supplied image; CC BY-SA 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ ; derived visual reconstruction attribution retained.

identity.feature: Single central round-topped gable with curved low shoulders, never red-house steps or twin gables
Dark round oculus over centred gable window
Two bays of small-pane windows and black historic anchor irons
